note: Distant city silhouette ring around the Hoan Kiem island (built by tools/asset_generator/generators/maps/hoan_kiem/outskirts_band.mjs into outskirts_band.glb). Every landmark stands at its real compass bearing from Turtle Tower; distances are squeezed (about 0.3x near the lake, less for the far row) so the whole city fits in about 120 m past the island edge. Old Quarter (tube houses, no towers) north and north-west, French Quarter (colonial blocks under big street trees) south and east, the Red River dyke and the river beyond it to the east. Heights: houses life-size like the map's own tube houses; towers shrunk to about 0.35x.

extent.note: Outer edge of the ground apron [min, max].

apron.note: Ground sinks to fade_y at `reach` metres from the island edge: y = fade_y * (d / reach)^power, so the far rows melt into the haze.

row_strength.note: Silhouette solidity, near rows to the far row (offset far_offset).

rows.note: Rows of lots parallel to each island edge, `offsets` metres out; north/south rows run the full `span` (they own the corners), west/east rows stay between them. A lot's style comes from the district at its centre.

old_quarter.note: Hanoi Old Quarter (the 36 streets): narrow tube houses (nha ong), 1-5 floors, tiled gables along the street, rooftop rooms and tanks. `front` widths widen per row so the far rows merge several houses per lot.

french_quarter.note: French Quarter: 3-5 storey colonial blocks and villas under the big street trees (xa cu, sau); a few later mid-rises in the back rows. Every lot outside old_quarter.rects.

streets.name: Hang Dao
streets.note: Old Quarter spine running north from Dong Kinh Nghia Thuc square (Hang Dao, Hang Ngang, Hang Duong) to Dong Xuan market.

streets.name: Ba Trieu
streets.note: South from the lake's south-west corner to Vincom Ba Trieu.

streets.name: Hang Bai
streets.note: South from the lake's south end (Hang Bai, then Hue street).

streets.name: Trang Tien
streets.note: From the lake's south-east corner east to the Opera House.

streets.name: Nha Tho
streets.note: Short street from Le Thai To to the cathedral square.

st_joseph_cathedral.note: Neo-Gothic twin bell towers (31.5 m real), about 200 m west of the lake; the facade faces east down Nha Tho street toward the lake.

bidv_tower.note: BIDV Tower, 35 Hang Voi: 106 m, 25 floors, the one tall building east of the lake, near Tran Quang Khai.

metropole.note: Sofitel Legend Metropole on Ngo Quyen: long white four-storey colonial hotel with a hipped roof, running north-south.

opera_house.note: Hanoi Opera House at the east end of Trang Tien; its portico faces west up the street toward the lake.

trang_tien_plaza.note: Trang Tien Plaza, French-style department store between Trang Tien, Hang Bai and Hai Ba Trung, just south-east of the lake.

hanoi_towers.note: Hanoi Towers, 49 Hai Ba Trung: the twin 27-floor Somerset Grand slabs plus the 14-floor office block, south-west of the lake.

vincom_ba_trieu.note: Vincom Center Ba Trieu: three 21-floor towers on a podium, about 1.5-2 km south (squeezed into the far row) at the end of Ba Trieu.

dong_xuan_market.note: Dong Xuan market (1889), about 1 km north at the top of the Old Quarter; three tall gables on its south front.

long_bien_bridge.note: Long Bien bridge (1903): brick viaduct over the Old Quarter's north edge, then the steel truss spans over the Red River, north-north-east of the lake.

dyke.note: Red River dyke (Tran Quang Khai / Tran Khanh Du) with its tree line, about 1 km east in real life.

river.note: The Red River beyond the dyke: a flat strip just under the apron, so it reads as pale water.
